images.seen: Europe with Cliopatria: Russian occupation of Lithuania hatched, Kingdom of Ireland and Scotland drawn as England's colony and member, Ottoman vassals in Ottoman tint, no stray speckles; looks right.

Morocco with Cliopatria: the Alaouite state (Morocco) is drawn holding the whole Saadi legacy around Marrakesh, the Souss edge and the Oriental (772 cells) 6 years before it took Fez (1666) or Marrakesh (1668); wrong.

Scandinavia with Denmark-Norway highlighted: Norway/Trondelag/Bornholm restored as the Treaty of Copenhagen says; a few thin slivers of Denmark-Norway inside Sweden in the published draft, already gone in the current dossiers (2 cells left).

Poland-Ukraine-Russia with Cliopatria: Andrusovo borders (Smolensk, Bryansk, left-bank Ukraine to Russia; Doroshenko's Hetmanate, Sloboda Ukraine, Zaporozhians) match the pages; Cliopatria shows none of the Cossack states.

South and Southeast Asia with Cliopatria: Mughal vassals Bijapur and Golconda in Mughal tint, Tibet in Khoshut tint, Nepal as small states (dossiers reject Cliopatria's Gorkha), Toungoo/Ayutthaya/Lan Na as expected; nothing out of place.
After the patch (stage): Morocco is the Tafilalt disc only, the Saadi legacy is nobody's, as the Alawi page has it until Fez 1666 and Marrakesh July 1668.

issues.what: Morocco (Alaouite) holds the Saadi legacy (about 695 cells: Marrakesh, Souss/Guelmim edge, Oriental, Tadla) from the 1660 anchor, then the morocco_1666 keyframe strips it (snap of -695 in 1666) and morocco_1668 gives it back (+877 in 1668). The Alawi page has only the Tafilalt until Fez (June 1666) and Marrakesh (July 1668).

Colony rule R1 gave 300 Haudenosaunee cells (central, western and northern New York, lon -79.7 to -73.4) to thirteen-colonies in 1664 because that keyframe draws all of present New York. The Province of New York page: no fixed western border, western New York 'disputed with the indigenous Iroquois Confederacy', upstate occupied by the Five Nations, the Duke exercised little control.

Skipped dutch-gold-coast events 1664 (loss, Axim and Egya) and 1665 (gain, Cormantin and Axim): the gazetteer has no 'Egya' or 'Cormantin'. Re-entered with Axim (1664) and Moree, which the gazetteer lists as Fort Amsterdam (Kormantin), plus Axim (1665). Fort Egya left out: the page gives no location.

Denmark-Norway / Swedish Empire size-rule conflict (145 cell-years, 1660 and 1662): Denmark-Norway's 1526 found shape leaves cells in Dalarna, Vastra Gotaland, Vasterbotten, Kronoberg in Sweden. A ruling was drafted, then withdrawn: in the current dossiers only 2 Swedish cells are left per year (edits since the 1 Nov compile), so the trial showed it settling 4 cell-years.

Cossack Hetmanate / Zaporozhian Cossacks conflict (281 cell-years, Kirovohrad 86, Poltava 46) and the zaporozhian-cossacks_1662 snap (+398): the Cliopatria Sich shape against the Hetmanate's 1649-1666 shape; the smaller state wins each patch of land. No page opened gives a boundary for the Wild Fields.

southern-ming_1662 (verdict wrong, shape still used at Cliopatria's years) puts 54 north and east Taiwan cells (Hualien, Yilan, Taoyuan) with Southern Ming and then Tungning in 1662-1663; the kingdom-of-tungning_1664 keyframe removes them. The Tungning page puts Zheng rule on the western plain only (Keelung Dutch to 1668).

kingdom-of-kongo_1662 keyframe (Cliopatria shape without Soyo) drops 267 cells (Uige, Bas-Congo, Bouenza) in 1662, three years before Mbwila (1665); the dossier calls the shape 'adjust' and has no ledger event for it.

Other large flags are correct as drawn: Safavid keeps Kandahar (75), Hunza and Kumaon beat the Mughal claim, Habsburg Netherlands keeps Cambrai, Saint-Omer and Aire until 1677 (Nord 15, Pas-de-Calais 6) and France keeps Lille, Douai, Tournai etc. from May 1668; the Comtat Venaissin occupations of 1663 and 1668 begin and end in the same year, so nothing is drawn at year end.

Aceh 1669 snap (+108: Sumatera Utara 89, Sumatera Barat 14) and its 26 cell-year conflict with the Dutch Republic on the Padang coast: the 1669 homeland shape reaches 14 west-coast cells the VOC held since 1666; small.

problems: Crossing the boundary: rulings/0 (thirteen-colonies over haudenosaunee, New York) covers 1664-1669 only. The keyframes thirteen-colonies_1673 and thirteen-colonies_1674 (window p1670-p1679), and later ones, claim the same 300 New York cells again and rule R1 would hand them to the colony; the p1670-p1679 agent needs a matching ruling (Haudenosaunee as winner, region New York, Province of New York page) or the cells are lost again from 1673.

The trial of 2 Nov also shows changes that are not mine, from dossier edits since the 1 Nov compile: denmark-norway/duchy-of-holstein conflict (46 cell-years, new), denmark-norway_1660 and first-toungoo-empire_1662 snaps (new), venetian-dalmatia conflicts changed; the packet's Denmark-Norway/Sweden numbers are out of date.

Morocco: the cause is the 1660 anchor, which the p1650-p1659 window produced (Saadi dissolve in 1659, Morocco as successor takes the Saadi land although the saadi-sultanate dossier carries it as nobody's until July 1668). events/0 repairs it from 1660; if the p1650-p1659 patch also changes the Saadi hand-over, events/0 becomes a no-op and is harmless.
Fez disc is nobody's 1662-1665 (dila-iya-sultanate/ledger/6, Fez lost to a putsch) and morocco gains it in June 1666: as the dossier says, not an error.

comtat-venaissin/ledger/3-6 record occupation_start with counterpart kingdom-of-france and the region the Comtat itself, which by the schema ('this state occupies region belonging to counterpart') reads as the Comtat occupying France; the packet lists the 1663 and 1668 relations as 'occupation of kingdom-of-france's land by comtat-venaissin' four times. Both start and end in one year, so no cells are drawn; a dossier tidy-up only.
Fort Egya (Ghana), 1664, is not in the gazetteer and the Dutch Gold Coast page gives no coordinates; its loss is not applied (about one cell).
